Turn 5 Mega Lucario Z Close Combat hit Urshifu for 178, Earth Power OHKO'd it, Surging Strikes KO'd Torterra. Turns 6-8 Toxtricity and Lilligant Protected once each; Earth Power 4x OHKO'd Toxtricity, Flare Blitz + Sludge Bomb KO'd Lilligant.

ai_notes: Staraptor never considered Final Gambit from full HP into the Sash Chi-Yu (Close Combat was the higher expected value, fair). Sylveon's Helping Hand on a partner about to be Fake Out flinched is a known weakness (it cannot see the Fake Out). No illegal choices.
level_change_rationale: Won first try with one faint but under real threat: Chi-Yu left at 1 HP turn 1, Mega Kangaskhan at 13 HP turn 2 to a single Wood Hammer, Urshifu to 150 from one Close Combat. Keep.
cooler: Threat density works: three different bodies each nearly removed a player Pokemon in one hit. The two pieces that never showed were Final Gambit and Victory Dance; both are AI-choice questions, not set questions. No change suggested.
